notes.title: Update 129 and price reduction.
notes.notes:
[h1]Updated with build 129:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added item descriptions to the inventory.[/list]
To the few dozen gamers who have supported [b]Greymen[/b] so far - a big thank you from us!!! You and your feedback were the reasons we did the recent updates! 

Unfortunately the game is not bringing in any beer money and we will have to lower the price.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Update to build 128.
notes.notes:
[h1]Updated with build 128:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Now you can turn the camera other than 180 degrees and look around you.
    [*]Added more flora to the wastes.
    [*]Fixed spawn issues when skipping the tutorial.
    [*]Improved animator and weapon in hand when facing north.
    [*]Tutorial hint added: click on the backpack to open the inventory
    [*]Tutorial hint added: Stand still and move your mouse to the corner of the screen to look around your position.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to build 127.
notes.notes:
Greetings wastelanders!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28852302/8ace8962566f4eaa290a0f9110cc154a9bb4b4e7.png[/img]
[h1]Updated with build 127:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Friendly cats and dogs make an appearance on the screen after rescuing them from the mutants.
    [*]The first three tutorial levels can be skipped by finding black smoke on the shores of the rotten sea.
    [*]Added more tutorial hints.
    [*]Fixed manhole layer problems.
    [*]Fixed walking animation sometimes starting when clicking an item in the inventory.
    [*]Fixed clicking on an item producing a sound when not in an underground battle.
    [*]Saves are now maintained between builds.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to build 125.
notes.notes:
[h1]Small update 125:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Black smoke added to the beginning of the game. Nearing that will give general tutorial hints in how to play the game or change weapons (mouse scroll wheel).
    [*]Fixed the second manhole giving you double the loot.
    [*]Looking back with the right click now correctly hides the sprite of the manhole to the back of the player.
    [*]Removed a lonely fence. 
    [*]Dying in battle will not give mutant teeth anymore.
[/list]
